item.title: BigFix Host Agent Client Deployment on OpenShift via GitOps
item.description: BigFix Host Agent Client Deployment on OpenShift via GitOps Overview This guide details the architecture, design decisions, and configuration required to deploy the HCL BigFix Host Agent Client onto a Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) cluster using Argo CD. This implementation rigorously adheres to and matches the standardized Helm component structures, sync-waves, and folder layouts defined in the helm-component-pattern artifact collection.

item.description: BigFix Inventory (BFI) Discovery & NFD Deployment via GitOps Overview This guide details the architecture, design decisions, and configuration required to deploy the HCL BigFix Inventory (BFI) discovery and sub-capacity licensing integration on Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP). This implementation rigorously adheres to and matches the standardized Helm component structures, sync-waves, and folder layouts defined in the helm-component-pattern artifact collection.
